summary: The claimed forest-interface bound follows with no mathematical error or gap. The proof covers k=8 separately and partitions all positive height deviations into exhaustive ranges, including their boundaries. The fixed-gap normalizer and capacity estimates are valid. In the small-deviation range, the two-term height normalizer is controlled, the low-height scalar estimates are applied only to entrance multiplicities with cutoff K, and both localized witness constructions use the original tree and its full-depth census. The terminal windows have the stated sizes and separation, and the partial-sum discard bound uses the window length K rather than k. All selected neighbors and endpoints are distinct within the family used, remain in GOOD with the same complete U-label, and have the required spatial and height weights. The fourth-power conditional normalization, actual sampling weights, and capacity transfer give constants stronger than the asserted 2^{-400}8^{-N}. Every predecessor is used with its stated support and child-block normalization, and all original column heights and ambient closed halfspaces are retained.
